name: DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.Uses_rename
typeText:
∀ {V F : Type} {arity : F → Nat} {V' F' : Type} {arity' : F' → Nat}
  (σ : DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv V F arity V' F' arity') (t : DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity) (z : V),
  Iff
    (DisequalityDispersion.Term.Uses (DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.rename σ t)
      ((DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.eV σ) z))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Term.Uses t z)

source.code:
theorem Uses_rename (t : Term V F arity) (z : V) :
    (σ.rename t).Uses (σ.eV z) ↔ t.Uses z := by
  induction t with
  | var v =>
      simp only [rename, Term.Uses]
      exact σ.eV.injective.eq_iff
  | app f ts ih =>
      simp only [rename, Term.Uses]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨Fin.cast (σ.har f) i, (ih _).mp hi⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        refine ⟨Fin.cast (σ.har f).symm i, ?_⟩
        have : Fin.cast (σ.har f) (Fin.cast (σ.har f).symm i) = i := by
          ext; rfl
        rw [this]
        exact (ih i).mpr hi
